body: Worker rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 21:08Z, learned on train-3a's w-cdba). Re-naming an item's source root (termal_name_source_root) bumps its root GENERATION, and any evidence bound to the earlier generation is then STALE for evaluation. w-cdba's pinned live witness 03378a29 at generation 1138 became insufficient after the Merger re-named the root (generation 1186) while moving focus. RULE: never re-name the root of an item that already has evidence at its current generation. Switch focus between held claims with a keyless claim renewal only, and re-name only an item whose root isn't named yet. When a multi-item train needs per-item evidence, name each item's root ONCE, before its first run.
